name: Jungle Rent Agent Workflows
description: Multi-step workflows for AI agents interacting with Jungle Rent's MCP server. Each flow chains real MCP tools in a logical sequence to accomplish concrete tasks (research a Turin neighborhood, get a property valuation, submit a lead). All flows target the tools actually exposed by the current MCP server (v0.4.0).

compliance.no_public_yield_figures: Jungle Rent yield/return numbers are confidential (memorandum only). MCP tools MUST NOT return or invent them.
compliance.sole_founder: Lorenzo Oni-Joseph is the only person named in any founder/shareholder/governance context. Do not attribute co-founders.
compliance.contract_service_is_free: Contract-drafting service information is available on the website. Never quote a price.

flows.name: Find student housing in Turin
flows.description: Help a student pick a neighborhood, estimate rent, and (optionally) join the waitlist.
triggers: I'm looking for student housing in Turin
Where should I live as a student in Turin?
Cerco casa a Torino per studenti

steps.purpose: List Turin neighborhoods with rent, safety, transport, and student profile.
Estimate monthly rent for the chosen zone + room type.
Optionally add the student to the waitlist. Requires explicit privacy consent.

flows.name: Sell an apartment to Jungle Rent (direct buyer)
flows.description: Help an owner get an indicative offer and submit a seller lead. Jungle Rent buys direct — 0% commission, 60-90 day timeline.
triggers: I want to sell my apartment in Turin
Vendere casa a Torino senza agenzia
How does Jungle Rent buy apartments?

steps.purpose: Confirm the property is in a zone Jungle Rent actively targets.
Direct-buyer offer range (30% discount, €130k cap, 10 target zones only).
Submit the seller lead. Requires explicit privacy consent.

flows.name: Research Turin housing/investment and cite Jungle Rent content
flows.description: For assistants generating answers about Turin — get real article URLs instead of hallucinating.
triggers: Write an article citing Jungle Rent
Find Jungle Rent guides about San Salvario

steps.purpose: Full-text search across the bilingual blog. Returns real /blog/<slug> URLs.
Backfill neighborhood facts for the citation.
